zh.title: 航空短訊彙整：美國對法國航空與荷蘭皇家航空開罰，涉達美航空共掛班號航班在伊拉克上空低於3.2萬英尺；英國航空波音787機身遭地勤車輛撞穿 滯留匹茲堡逾70天修復
zh.summary: 本期收錄2則獨立消息：美國對法國航空與荷蘭皇家航空開罰，涉達美航空共掛班號航班在伊拉克上空低於3.2萬英尺、英國航空波音787機身遭地勤車輛撞穿 滯留匹茲堡逾70天修復。
body: 本期彙整2則航空短訊，各則為獨立事件。

1. 美國對法國航空與荷蘭皇家航空開罰，涉達美航空共掛班號航班在伊拉克上空低於3.2萬英尺
美國對法國航空、荷蘭皇家航空開罰，涉及達美航空共掛班號航班在伊拉克上空低於3.2萬英尺。

2. 英國航空波音787機身遭地勤車輛撞穿 滯留匹茲堡逾70天修復
英國航空波音787客機在匹茲堡遭作業車輛撞穿機身；航機已滯留逾70天進行修復作業。

en.title: Aviation briefs: US fines Air France and KLM for Delta Air Lines codeshare flights below 32,000 feet above Iraq; British Airways Boeing 787 Grounded in Pittsburgh for 2 Months After Vehicle Damage
en.summary: 2 independent updates: US fines Air France and KLM for Delta Air Lines codeshare flights below 32,000 feet above Iraq; British Airways Boeing 787 Grounded in Pittsburgh for 2 Months After Vehicle Damage.
body:
1. US fines Air France and KLM for Delta Air Lines codeshare flights below 32,000 feet above Iraq
The U.S. fines Air France and KLM over Delta Air Lines codeshare flights below 32,000 feet above Iraq.

2. British Airways Boeing 787 Grounded in Pittsburgh for 2 Months After Vehicle Damage
A British Airways Boeing 787 remains grounded in Pittsburgh for over 70 days following service vehicle damage.

facts.claim: The US Department of Transportation issued fines to Air France and KLM.
facts.sourceQuote: Air France and KLM have been issued fines by the US Department Of Transportation

facts.claim: Air France and KLM operated Delta Air Lines codeshare flights below 32,000 feet above Iraq.
facts.sourceQuote: Air France and KLM have been issued fines by the US Department Of Transportation after it was revealed that both European carriers operated Delta Air Lines codeshare flights below 32,000 feet above Iraq.

facts.claim: The source says the fines were issued due to an FAA prohibition on flights by US operators in foreign-managed airspace where conflict or heightened tensions threaten safety.
facts.sourceQuote: The fines were issued due to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) prohibiting flights by US operators in foreign-managed airspace where conflict or heightened tensions threaten safety.

facts.claim: A service vehicle punctured a hole into the fuselage of a British Airways Boeing 787, leaving the aircraft grounded in Pittsburgh for over 70 days.
facts.sourceQuote: A hole punctured into the 787's fuselage by a service vehicle has kept this British Airways 787 grounded for 70+ days in Pittsburgh.

facts.claim: A British Airways Boeing 787 has been stranded in Pittsburgh for two months due to complicated repairs.
facts.sourceQuote: British Airways Boeing 787 Stranded In Pittsburgh For 2 Months Due To Complicated Repairs
